info.name: Application Performance Monitoring Control Plane Apm Domain API
Gets a list of all APM domains in a compartment

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the entire display name given.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given life-cycle state.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page at which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending. If no value is specified, timeCreated is default.

items.docs: Lists all APM domains for the specified tenant compartment.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The OCID of the APM domain.

items.docs: Gets the details of the APM domain specified by OCID.

info.name: Update the APM domain identified by the id

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The OCID of the APM domain.

info.name: Deletes the APM domain identified by id.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The OCID of the APM domain.

items.docs:
Deletes the specified APM domain asynchronously. The APM domain is placed in the 'Deleting' state and will stop
accepting any operation requests. All resources associated with the APM domain are eventually recovered. Use the
returned work request ID to track the progress of the background activity to complete deleting the APM domain.

info.name: Moves an APM domain into a different compartment

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The OCID of the APM domain.

items.docs: Moves an APM domain into a different compartment. When provided, If-Match is checked against ETag values of the APM domain.

info.name: Generates a set of new Data Keys for the specified APM domain.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The OCID of the APM domain.

items.docs:
Generates a set of new Data Keys for the specified APM domain with the specified names and
types. These will be added to the existing set of Data Keys for the specified APM domain.

info.name: Removes the set of specified Data Keys from the specified APM domain.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The OCID of the APM domain.

items.docs:
Removes the set of specified Data Keys from the specified APM domain. Agents would no longer
be able to use these data keys to upload to the APM domain once this operation is completed.

info.name: Gets a list of all Data Keys for a given APM domain.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The OCID of the APM domain.

params.name: dataKeyType
params.description: Data key type.

items.docs:
Lists all Data Keys for the specified APM domain. The caller may filter the list by specifying the 'dataKeyType'
query parameter.
